title: Lightly Pressure-Cooked Ukrainian Eggs Bake
description: A hearty, wholegrain mustard-infused brunch dish featuring silky Ukrainian-style eggs and a nutritious, whole30-friendly twist.
instructions: In a large pressure cooker, combine the eggs, wholegrain mustard, and salt.
Add 1 cup of water to the pressure cooker and cook on high pressure for 5 minutes.
Quick-release the pressure and carefully open the lid.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the red onion to the saucepan and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the chopped chives and cook for an additional minute.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Dot the top with the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until the eggs are set and golden brown.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
